capability.summary: Look up English definitions and phonetics for one word
capability.description: Fetches the Free Dictionary API English entry endpoint for one word and returns definitions, meanings, phonetics, and provider metadata in the shared JSON envelope. It is lexical lookup, not synonym generation or translation.
capability.problem_space: English lexical entry lookup for definitions and pronunciation metadata; not word association, translation, spelling correction, or language tutoring.

constraint.io_signature: Input: word path value at CLI position 1. Output: shared JSON envelope containing Free Dictionary API entry array or provider error, URL, and HTTP status. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
accepted_inputs: one English word or phrase path segment
constraint.output_shape: HTTP 2xx/3xx: {status: "success", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}. HTTP 4xx/5xx: {status: "error", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}, exit 1. Request exception: {status: "error", tool: string, message: string}, exit 1.
limitations: no language selection, part-of-speech filter, synonym query, pagination, or batch input; all CLI arguments after position 1 are ignored
wrapper does not URL-encode, parse, paginate, or truncate the provider entry array
missing input is not validated and is interpolated into the path
HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.

output_contract.description: Shared JSON envelope containing Free Dictionary API definitions, meanings, phonetics, URL, and HTTP status.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: look up an English word definition
negative_intents: translate a word or generate a language lesson
